title: PromptInfuser: How Tightly Coupling AI and UI Design Impacts Designers’ Workflows
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This paper introduces PromptInfuser, a Figma plugin that enables designers to connect UI elements to LLM prompts, creating semi-functional mockups. The study compares PromptInfuser with traditional workflows, showing it improves communication, efficiency, and anticipation of issues.
